items.title: 13.11.2 Disinfection activity (jaraseem maarne ka kaam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.11.2, printed page 301.

blocks.text: HOCl aur OCl⁻ dono effective (asar wale) disinfectants hain, lekin HOCl zyada effective hai kyun ke is par koi charge nahi (neutral hai). Neutral hone ki wajah se HOCl micro-organisms (itne chhote jaandaar jo sirf microscope se dikhte hain) ki cell walls mein aasani se andar chala jata hai. HOCl aur OCl⁻ cell ke zaroori hisson, jaise proteins aur lipids (fat jaisi cheezen), ko oxidize kar dete hain; is se cell ka kaam bigar jata hai aur cell mar jata hai. HOCl aur OCl⁻ un enzymes ko bhi oxidize kar ke inactivate (bekaar) kar dete hain jo bacteria ke zinda rehne aur barhne (replication) ke liye zaroori hain.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: HOCl aur OCl⁻ nucleic acids (DNA aur RNA) ko bhi oxidize kar sakte hain; is tarah bacteria replicate nahi kar pate (apni copies nahi bana pate) aur un ke zaroori cell ke kaam ruk jate hain.

blocks.caption: Active species bacteria ko kaise maarti hain

items: HOCl (neutral) OCl⁻ se behtar cell walls ke andar jata hai, is liye zyada effective hai.
Dono proteins, lipids, enzymes aur DNA/RNA ko oxidize kar ke bacteria ko maarte hain.
